title: DO_KDF ioctl declared in UAPI but not implemented — returns -ENOTTY
description: CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF (slot 22) is added to crypto2dev_ioctl.h with full struct and documentation. The ioctl dispatch in crypto2dev_fd.c has no case for it; the default: branch returns -ENOTTY. Comments in fd.c even say inbuf accumulates for 'KEY_IMPORT or DO_KDF'. Any caller that includes the header and calls the ioctl gets -ENOTTY with no indication this is a stub. This is a shipped broken UAPI: the header is a promise, and the promise is not kept. Trigger: any process calls CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF on an UNSET fd. Bad behavior: returns -ENOTTY instead of performing KDF.
